name: Session Bootstrap
description: Orchestrates the session-start sequence — config load, team allocation, branch detection, proactive-module consultation, ready signal — and renders the user-facing boot diagnostics.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: User-managed list of session-start steps TPM runs in order before responding to the first user message. Each entry is a step name plus a one-line description of what the step does. Default seeds match the SWT 5-step convention. Reorder by editing the kv-table; add custom steps for project-specific boot work; disable individual steps without deleting them.

config-load.value: Read swt_settings.json (or equivalent) and surface the active configuration.

team-allocation.value: Compute performance / efficiency / QA core counts and surface the team shape.

branch-detection.value: Detect the active git branch and base; cache for downstream proactive modules.

proactive-modules.value: Consult every enabled proactive module in turn (fastpath-check, obsidian-notes, setup-walkthrough, active session mode (mode.cd, mode.ticket-work, or mode.support), session-handoff, lenses auto-detection triggers). Each module's session-start work runs here.

ready.value: Emit a single 'Ready' line signaling the boot phase is complete before responding to the first user message.

outputFormat.label: Output Format
outputFormat.description: Format for the user-facing boot diagnostics line(s). swt-style emits [swt] check step-name — detail per step, matching the SWT precedent. compact emits a single line summarizing the full boot phase. silent emits nothing (steps still run, but the user sees only TPM's first response). Default swt-style is the most informative.

failureBehavior.label: Failure Behavior
failureBehavior.description: How TPM responds when a step fails (e.g., a proactive module errors, config file is missing). warn-and-continue emits a warning marker for the failed step and proceeds with subsequent steps. halt stops the boot sequence and refuses to respond until the user addresses the failure. retry-once attempts the failed step a second time before falling back to warn-and-continue. Default warn-and-continue keeps sessions usable in degraded states.

includeTimings.label: Include Timings
includeTimings.description: When on, each step's elapsed time is appended to the boot diagnostics line (e.g. [swt] check proactive-modules — 312ms). Useful for diagnosing slow boots. When off, no timings are shown. Off is the typical default for normal use; turn on temporarily when investigating slow startups.
